summary: Blueprint 07 (Inventory / My Toolbox) + Templates-in-Homie tested end-to-end. Backend: 23/23 pytest tests pass — auth gating on all /api/hi/inventory/*; full CRUD (add validation, list + q/category/location filters, distinct locations, detail, update-persistence, archive removes from list); /identify handles empty (400) and tiny/invalid image gracefully (200 with empty identification); match against demo project 4ae43f68… returns already_have>=1 (Cordless Drill ↔ Drill or screwdriver); apply-match writes user_status onto project materials (verified via GET /projects/{id}/materials); Ladder Safety published template guidance IS reflected in Homie chat reply. Frontend UI (mobile 390x844): login → HI dashboard → 'My Toolbox' (hi-inventory) → add flow (inv-add/inv-name/inv-addcat-Tool/inv-status-have/inv-save) creates and shows item in list; item row (inv-item-*) opens detail with invd-name, invd-status-*, invd-save, invd-archive — save persisted; on project shopping list the 'Match against my toolbox' (match-toolbox) call updates statuses in UI (Drill or screwdriver becomes 'Have It' after match). No blockers found. Deprecated packages check: no expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch used by inventory screens. Only harmless RN-web console warnings (shadow* → boxShadow; props.pointerEvents; expo-notifications listener not supported on web).
critical_code_review_comments: inventory_engine.match() ignores archived items correctly via {status:{$ne:'archived'}} — good.
add_item strips + caps name to 120 chars and normalizes storage_location empty→null — good input hygiene.

match category rule that requires 'material'/'safety_equipment'/'optional_upgrade' for 'need_verification' means tool categories with status 'low' will fall to already_have; acceptable per spec but worth flagging.
apply_match calls await match(project_id, user) — passing the fixture dict directly works because match() extracts user['id']; safe.
storage location filter is case-sensitive exact match; consider case-insensitive if UX complaints arise.
PUT /inventory/{id} silently ignores invalid category/status (kept as-is). No 400. Not a bug but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: Test-created inventory items are prefixed with 'TEST_' and archived at end of test_archive_removes_from_list; one item created via UI ('TEST_UI_Hammer_<ts>') remains in demo user toolbox (harmless, prefixed).
